1. Daiva Pupšytė — ASK Klinika / private (Krokuvos g. 60). Psychiatrist-psychotherapist. Explicitly lists ADHD diagnosis. Reviews describe attentive listening. Phone: +370 686 81482. TOP PICK — probably has private availability within days.
2. Dr. Kęstutis Kuzmickas — pssc.lt (Žirmūnų psichikos sveikatos centras). Personally vouched on r/lithuania. Experienced with adult ADHD.
Also: Mednetas (AB Mednetas) and Neuromeda (larger clinic, less single-doctor risk). Facebook group 'ADHD Lietuva' for crowdsourced current recs.
